instruction: Navigate to artist 1 at /artist/1. What is the artist name?
Search at /api/search?q=Rock. Does it return artist results?
Go to /api/artists/1. What genre is this artist?
Go to /api/genres. Does it list 'Electronic'?
POST /api/login with username 'alex_chen' and password 'pass123'. Does it succeed?
Filter artists at /api/artists?genre=Electronic. Are all results Electronic?
Sort artists at /api/artists?sort=listeners. Is the first artist top by listeners?
Search at /api/semantic_search?q=folk+acoustic+guitar. Does it return results?
Get stats at /api/stats. Does it return total_tracks?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/play with type=track, id=1. Does it start playing?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/playback with action=pause. Does it pause?
Go to /api/genres. Does it list genre names with counts?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/share with type=track, id=1, platform=link. Does it return share_url?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/playlists with name='Test Playlist'. Does it return 201?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/artists/1/follow. Does it toggle follow?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/tracks/1/like. Does it toggle like?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/subscribe with type=artist, id=1. Does it toggle subscription?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/library/follow with artist_id=2. Does it toggle follow?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/play/date_range with date_from=2023-01-01, date_to=2025-12-31. Does it start playing?
Log in as alex_chen/pass123, POST /api/playlists/1/add with track_id=2. Does it add the track?
